race.comment: STAPHANI (10) is a lightly raced mare who was okay to this trip at Seymour on heavy going last start when midfield. Keen to see her on top of the ground for the first time here, she can improve in what looks a very winnable race. LIGHTNING FLASH (3) is racing well, coming off a dominant 4.5 length win at Wodonga in easier. She can measure up in that sort of form. SAXON BLOOD (5) has won two on the bounce and did win in this grade down in the weights two back. Will take catching again. NICOFFHOME (4) is another that can go forward, he stuck on well last time and should run well from the inside gate.
